revision: Actual application repo_revision/state/pending read through MCP before/after; unchanged READY required; no use of vendor Graph version as application revision.
trace: B06 sanitized process-local trace list and explicit operator evidence JSON; graph-backed common ToolExecution envelope/persistence remains B07/B17.
security_limits: Template/field/label/property bounds enforced by broker; DB ACL enforces graph key and read-only commands.
Same-user administrator/default local DB developer credentials remain privileged; no OS sandbox claim.
Client timeout abandons/invalidate session; official tool lacks query-timeout argument. Fixed bounded templates; no claim client cancellation interrupts DB query.
